title: The missing connection
use: A fill-in-the-blank answer, a missing step, a completed argument or a repaired connection.
description: Two ceramic beam ends leave a real center gap. A contrasting insert aligns with two guide rails, descends into the space, and remains seated.
copy: Use --pos 0 for the question poster with its visible gap. Hold the native sentence with a blank, then start the non-looping insertion clip on the answer beat and reveal the exact missing text. The physical piece carries no lettering.
metaphor: A visual completion metaphor, not an interactive input field, factual mechanical assembly, or proof that a learner supplied the correct answer.
